notes:
• Operator: a to-do started in a workspace shows once instead of twice. It stays in the to-do list with its workspace's state while the workspace works or is quiet, and moves up under Needs you, Failed or Ready, with the chat's line, when the workspace has something for you. A tap on the workspace under the to-do opens the chat that needs you. Workspaces without a to-do keep their own lines.
• Stellwerk for Mac: a project's "Team chats" block starts collapsed in the sidebar when the project has no team chats. Opened by hand, it stays open; as soon as team chats arrive, it opens by itself. iPhone, iPad and Android show no block without team chats, so nothing changes there.
• Operator: a finished chat stays under Ready until you write in it, close it or archive its workspace. Opening it no longer takes it off the list, and a turn that ends while you watch shows up there too.
